sourceRecords.title: Damping Pool® floating foundation for Buchan Offshore Wind receives DNV Basic Design Certification
sourceRecords.sourceText: DNV awarded Basic Design Certification to the concrete Damping Pool floating support structure designed by BW Ideol for Buchan Offshore Wind. The certificate covers the site-specific North Sea design and was presented on 7 October 2026. It follows certification of the standard 15 MW+ platform in 2025.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Subsea Micropiles secures agreement with Pentland Floating Offshore Wind Farm
sourceRecords.sourceText: Subsea Micropiles announced collaboration with Pentland Floating Offshore Wind Farm on site investigation, anchor design, cyclic loading analysis and offshore installation expertise. The agreement was signed on 28 September. Zonal surveys and Acoustic Zoom subsurface imaging will support better-informed anchor design. No final anchor supply award or installed system is announced.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: 浮体式洋上風力発電向け係留システム新技術を担うTFI Marine社とのパートナーシップ契約を締結
sourceRecords.sourceText: Sumitomo Corporation Global Metals and TFI Marine signed a partnership to promote SeaSpring for floating offshore wind. SCGM describes SeaSpring as a mooring device intended to reduce loads and fatigue, allowing smaller components and supporting a future Japanese mooring supply chain. The announcement is a technology partnership, not a project-specific procurement award.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: £3 million investment to advance EMEC DeepWind test and demonstration site
sourceRecords.sourceText: UKRI awarded EMEC GBP 3 million over two years to advance DeepWind, a proposed floating and deepwater wind test site. Engineering, environmental, regulatory and commercial work will support an FID and preparation for delivery by 2030. The funding does not itself confirm FID or an operating test site.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Landmark new study sets out scope and method to cut costs in floating offshore wind
sourceRecords.sourceText: ORE Catapult published a method for tracking floating offshore wind cost drivers, identifying 21 reduction factors across seven UK scenarios. Its analysis estimates up to 17 percent savings from substructure standardisation and almost 20 percent from aligning capital costs with fixed-bottom wind. These are individual levers, not additive savings or one overall forecast.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: GWEC Floating Wind Initiative Sets Out Industry Plan for Accelerating Commercial-Scale Projects
sourceRecords.sourceText: GWEC and more than fifty organisations released an action plan through the Floating Wind Industry Accelerator. It addresses cost reduction, access to finance and insurance, and supply-chain infrastructure and standardisation. Recommendations include credible auction schedules, revenue frameworks, and timely port, grid and consenting decisions to help first-mover projects reach FID before 2030.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Offshore Wind: France Energies Marines Launches Four New Research and Innovation Projects
sourceRecords.sourceText: France Energies Marines approved four projects involving 33 partners and nearly EUR 10 million for launch in autumn 2026. ACT NOW addresses cumulative ecosystem impacts; GLAMOOR investigates seawater degradation and fatigue of PA 6 mooring ropes; QUANTUM studies biocolonisation; TULIP develops turbulence measurement methods using fixed and floating LiDAR. These are planned R&D activities, not completed results.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public announcement or article; concise attributed factual paraphrase retained, not full source text. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Global floating offshore wind pipeline October 2026
sourceRecords.sourceText: RenewableUK's public October EnergyPulse summary reports 382 MW operational floating offshore wind and 109 MW newly operational in 2026. Its tracked snapshot covers 300 active projects across 26 countries and 152 GW operational or under development. The full report is member or subscriber content; only the public summary is used.

briefingItems.title: SCGM and TFI Marine partner on SeaSpring mooring technology
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: SCGM and TFI Marine agreed to promote SeaSpring load- and fatigue-reduction technology for floating-wind moorings.
briefingItems.explanation: Sumitomo Corporation Global Metals and TFI Marine signed a partnership to promote SeaSpring for floating offshore wind. SCGM describes SeaSpring as a mooring device intended to reduce loads and fatigue, allowing smaller components and supporting a future Japanese mooring supply chain. The announcement is a technology partnership, not a project-specific procurement award.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The partnership concerns mooring component industrialisation; company-described benefits remain distinct from verified project delivery.

briefingItems.title: GWEC sets out floating-wind commercialisation action plan
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: GWEC's floating-wind action plan calls for coordinated auctions, finance, port and grid infrastructure, and standardisation.
briefingItems.explanation: GWEC and more than fifty organisations released an action plan through the Floating Wind Industry Accelerator. It addresses cost reduction, access to finance and insurance, and supply-chain infrastructure and standardisation. Recommendations include credible auction schedules, revenue frameworks, and timely port, grid and consenting decisions to help first-mover projects reach FID before 2030.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The statement identifies coordinated policy and infrastructure requirements for commercial-scale floating wind.

briefingItems.title: Pentland collaboration targets anchor engineering and seabed investigation
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Pentland and Subsea Micropiles announced an anchor-design and site-investigation collaboration signed on 28 September.
briefingItems.explanation: Subsea Micropiles announced collaboration with Pentland Floating Offshore Wind Farm on site investigation, anchor design, cyclic loading analysis and offshore installation expertise. The agreement was signed on 28 September. Zonal surveys and Acoustic Zoom subsurface imaging will support better-informed anchor design. No final anchor supply award or installed system is announced.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The stated work addresses seabed uncertainty and anchor design; procurement and installation completion are not confirmed.

briefingItems.title: EnergyPulse reports 382 MW of operational floating offshore wind
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: RenewableUK's public EnergyPulse summary reports 382 MW operating and a 152 GW tracked floating-wind development landscape.
briefingItems.explanation: RenewableUK's public October EnergyPulse summary reports 382 MW operational floating offshore wind and 109 MW newly operational in 2026. Its tracked snapshot covers 300 active projects across 26 countries and 152 GW operational or under development. The full report is member or subscriber content; only the public summary is used.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The summary distinguishes operating capacity from the much larger development pipeline.

briefingItems.title: ORE Catapult publishes floating-wind cost reduction methodology
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: A new ORE Catapult methodology identifies standardisation, financing and sustained deployment as floating-wind cost levers.
briefingItems.explanation: ORE Catapult published a method for tracking floating offshore wind cost drivers, identifying 21 reduction factors across seven UK scenarios. Its analysis estimates up to 17 percent savings from substructure standardisation and almost 20 percent from aligning capital costs with fixed-bottom wind. These are individual levers, not additive savings or one overall forecast.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The method separates technology and financing drivers rather than claiming a single guaranteed cost reduction.
